segments.text: Have some really cool ideas around this new video for the launch of the Ivy product. It has Arabella running through a street defending off bad guys. And then at the end of that, she jumps over a roof and then opens up the device in her hands and then radios through and says, I've got it.
Oh, and by the way, I just forgot. I need to have milk for the office for Thursday.

cards.title: Launch video: rooftop chase, "I've got it"
cards.gist: A launch video where the performer runs through a street fending off bad guys, jumps over a roof, opens the device in her hands and radios through "I've got it."
cards.frame_brief: a woman mid-leap over a rooftop edge, holding an open small handheld device in one hand, a narrow street below

actions.text: Get milk for the office for Thursday
actions.frame_brief: a carton of milk standing on an office kitchen counter beside mugs
